scope: Callable tools exposed through this Codex session's ALL_TOOLS registry; UI/orchestration wrappers are additional surfaces, not included in this count.
target: Track a verified LocalBot equivalent or an authenticated integration for every entry. Unimplemented and unavailable entries are not completion.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.route: apply_patch supports multi-file Add/Update/Delete, Move to, exact @@ hunks and End of File; all existing sources require read_file SHA-256, every patch requires approval, recovery preimages retained. Strict unique matching; not the full fuzzy Codex parser or crash-atomic filesystem transactions.

tools.name: clock__curr_time
tools.route: current_time reads the runtime system clock and returns ISO UTC, Unix milliseconds, IANA zone local time and UTC offset; defaults to UTC.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.route: Persistent conversation-scoped goals with active/blocked/complete state and evidence; no token budgeting, usage accounting or autonomous scheduling yet.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.route: Sandboxed process_start/process_poll/process_input/process_stop with task/agent/workspace ownership, bounded output, stdin, five-minute lifetime and cleanup. No PTY, persistent detached jobs or network access. process_poll supports cancellable output/exit waits up to 60 seconds (10 seconds by default), with 0 for immediate snapshots.

tools.name: read_mcp_resource
tools.route: mcp_read_resource: per-read approval and integration permission checks; server-mediated URI reads, validated bounded text/base64 contents.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.route: Persistent conversation-scoped goals with active/blocked/complete state and evidence; no token budgeting, usage accounting or autonomous scheduling yet.

tools.name: view_image
tools.route: view_image reads validated workspace pictures with filesystem permission, retains an artifact and passes multimodal input through Codex CLI or opt-in Ollama/OpenAI-compatible providers. Codex live verified; HTTP protocol verified; actual local vision inference and resolution controls remain unverified/unimplemented.

tools.name: web__run
tools.route: web_fetch: bounded public HTTPS text retrieval, up to five revalidated redirects, pinned DNS, final source URL and UTF-8 text. Search, finance, weather and browser actions are not implemented.

tools.name: write_stdin
tools.route: Sandboxed process_start/process_poll/process_input/process_stop with task/agent/workspace ownership, bounded output, stdin, five-minute lifetime and cleanup. No PTY, persistent detached jobs or network access. process_poll supports cancellable output/exit waits up to 60 seconds (10 seconds by default), with 0 for immediate snapshots.
